Patch round to the same card thread: the arm on the PR body and changeset, the BREAKING paragraph with FROM → TO, one `adr-0087:` marker, a `Skills-docs:` line, the dogfood battery on the final head, and the two should-fixes. A fresh record follows on the new head. Everything else in the claim stands.
